# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No additional fixes were required in this stage. I reviewed the latest validation output, confirmed the implementation was approved with no follow-up amendments, and made no further code or test changes.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Reviewed the latest review output for actionable follow-up items on the trim/export work.
1. [Completed] Confirmed the review outcome was approved and that all acceptance criteria were already satisfied by the existing implementation and prior fixes.
2. [Skipped] Skipped further code edits and test changes because no additional fixes were requested.

## Validation Evidence

- No new validation was required in this stage because the latest review outcome was `approved` with no follow-up amendments.
- Prior authoritative validation remains green: `cargo test -p tank_core` passed for the full package suite, including save/load migration coverage and trim/export regressions.
- Prior targeted evidence remains valid: `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load`, `cargo test -p tank_core --test budget_helpers`, `cargo test -p tank_core --test plant_algae_integration`, and the exact trim/export regression tests all passed in earlier stages.

None identified.
